justification: δόξαν, accusative of δόξα; Morpheus marks it only Doric/Aeolic (its Attic δόξα declines in -η), so ranking would file it under δοκέω's aorist participle.
ποιητοῦ, genitive of ποιητής 'poet' (τὸ τοῦ ποιητοῦ, Alc. II 147b); Morpheus marks it only Ionic, so ranking would file it under ποιητός 'made'.
ἡμερῶν, genitive plural of ἡμέρα 'day'; Morpheus marks it only Ionic, so ranking would file it under ἡμερόω 'tame'.
ἡμίσεα, neuter plural of ἥμισυς 'half' (τὰ δ' ἡμίσεα, Laws 672e); Morpheus marks it only epic/Ionic, so ranking would file it under a glossless ἡμίσεια.
ᾖα, the Attic imperfect of εἶμι 'go' (ἐπ' ἄλλον ᾖα, Apol. 21d); Morpheus marks it only epic/Ionic, so ranking would file it under ἤια 'provisions'.
σκιάς, accusative plural of σκιά 'shadow' (the cave, Rep. 515a); Morpheus marks it only Ionic, so ranking would file it under σκιάς 'canopy'.
σκιῶν, genitive plural of σκιά 'shadow' (Rep. 532b); Morpheus marks it only Ionic, so ranking would file it under σκιάω 'overshadow'.
φύλαξιν, dative plural of φύλαξ 'guardian'; Morpheus marks it only epic, so ranking would file it under φύλαξις 'guarding'.
φύλαξι, dative plural of φύλαξ 'guardian'; Morpheus marks it only epic, so ranking would file it under φύλαξις 'guarding'.
θεατῶν, genitive plural of θεατής 'spectator' (τῷ ὄχλῳ τῶν θεατῶν, Gorg. 502a); Morpheus marks it only Ionic, so ranking would file it under θεατός 'to be seen'.
θεατάς, accusative plural of θεατής 'spectator'; Morpheus marks it only Ionic, so ranking would file it under θεατός 'to be seen'.
θεαταῖς, dative plural of θεατής 'spectator'; Morpheus marks it only Ionic, so ranking would file it under θεατός 'to be seen'.
θεαταί, nominative plural of θεατής 'spectator'; Morpheus marks it only Ionic, so ranking would file it under θεατός 'to be seen'.
θέων, 'running', participle of θέω (ὁ εὖ θέων, Hipp. Min. 373d); Morpheus marks it only non-Attic, so ranking would file it under a glossless θεόν.
θέω, 'I run' (τέλος γὰρ ἤδη θέω, Crat. 420d); Morpheus marks it only non-Attic, so ranking would file it under a glossless θεόν.
θέωσιν, subjunctive of θέω 'run' (ὅσοι ἂν θέωσιν, Rep. 613b); Morpheus marks it only non-Attic, so ranking would file it under θέωσις 'deification'.
ἔσοιτο, future optative of εἰμί (Apol. 36c); Morpheus marks it only epic, so ranking would file it under εἰσίημι.
ἐσοίμην, future optative of εἰμί (Ep. VII 328c); Morpheus marks it only Doric, so ranking would file it under εἰσίημι.
ἰάσασθαι, aorist of ἰάομαι 'heal' (Attic keeps ᾱ after ι); Morpheus marks it only Doric/Aeolic, so ranking would file it under a glossless ἰάζω.
ἰάσαιο, aorist of ἰάομαι 'heal' (Attic keeps ᾱ after ι); Morpheus marks it only Doric/Aeolic, so ranking would file it under a glossless ἰάζω.
ἰάσηται, aorist of ἰάομαι 'heal' (Attic keeps ᾱ after ι); Morpheus marks it only Doric/Aeolic, so ranking would file it under a glossless ἰάζω.
ἰάσατο, aorist of ἰάομαι 'heal' (Attic keeps ᾱ after ι); Morpheus marks it only Doric/Aeolic, so ranking would file it under a glossless ἰάζω.
ἰασάμενος, aorist of ἰάομαι 'heal' (Attic keeps ᾱ after ι); Morpheus marks it only Doric/Aeolic, so ranking would file it under a glossless ἰάζω.
ἰάσομαι, 'I will heal' (Gorg. 447b), future of ἰάομαι; Morpheus marks it only Doric/Aeolic, so ranking would file it under a glossless ἰάζω.
χρῶ, imperative of χράομαι 'use' (Gorg. 466a); Morpheus marks it only Ionic, so ranking would file it under χράω 'fall upon'.
οἰήθητε, aorist of οἴομαι (Apol. 18e); Morpheus marks it only Homeric/Ionic, so ranking would file it under a glossless οἰάω.
ἀράς, accusative plural of ἀρά 'curse' (Critias 119e); Morpheus marks it only Ionic, so ranking would file it under the epic form ἀρή.
ἀποικιῶν, genitive plural of ἀποικία 'colony' (Laws 740e); Morpheus marks it only Ionic, so ranking would file it under ἀποικίζω.
δεξιῶν, genitive plural of δεξιός 'right' (ἐκ τῶν δεξιῶν, Tim. 77e); Morpheus marks δεξιά's reading only Ionic, so ranking would file it under δεξιάζω 'approve'.
οἷ is mostly the adverb 'whither', which Morpheus does not offer, and sometimes the reflexive 'to him' (Charm. 159b); ranking would file it under the article, which never takes a circumflex.
τοῖσιν, the epic and old Attic dative plural of the article (Laws 680b, 717a); ranking would file it under an Attic dative of τίς.
τοῖσι, the epic and old Attic dative plural of the article; ranking would file it under an Attic dative of τίς.
ὀρέων, uncontracted genitive plural of ὄρος 'mountain', in Homer quoted at Laws 680b; ranking would file it under ὀρεύς 'mule'.
νόου, uncontracted genitive of νόος 'mind', in Homer quoted at Laws 777a; ranking would file it under νοόω.
ἠέλιος, the epic ἥλιος 'sun', in Homer quoted at Ion 539a; ranking would file it under a lemma glossed 'ah!'.
δηίων, 'of the foe', epic δήιος in Tyrtaeus quoted at Laws 629e and 661a (also spelt δηΐων); ranking would file it under δηιόω 'slay'.
δύω, 'two', in Homer quoted at Rep. 393a; ranking would file it under a glossless δύω.
ἀρετῶν, genitive plural of ἀρετή (σμῆνος ἀρετῶν, Meno 72a); Morpheus puts ἀρετάω 'thrive' first, as an Attic participle the ranking leaves first.
εἴρηται, perfect of ἐρῶ 'say'; Morpheus marks the Attic perfect epic/Ionic and puts ἔρομαι 'ask' first, and ranking would file it under εἴρω 'fasten'.
εἴρησθον, dual perfect of ἐρῶ 'say' (Phaedr. 243c); Morpheus marks it epic/Ionic and puts ἔρομαι 'ask' first, and ranking would file it under εἴρω 'fasten'.
διείρηται, perfect of διερῶ 'say distinctly'; Morpheus marks it epic/Ionic and puts διείρομαι first, and ranking would file it under διείρω 'pass through'.

οἳ, the relative pronoun (163 of the 250 tokens; the article before an enclitic takes this accent too, οἵ γε, Alc. I 117e); Morpheus puts the epic pronoun ἑ first, and ranking would file it under the article.
οἵπερ, the relative ὅσπερ; Morpheus puts the epic pronoun ἑ first, and ranking would file it under the article.
τοί, the particle τοι accented before an enclitic (γάρ τοί, Gorg. 484c); Morpheus puts the epic article first, and ranking would file it under σύ.
χρῆν, imperfect of χρή 'it was needful' (Apol. 17a); Morpheus puts χράω 'fall upon' first, and ranking would file it under χράω 'proclaim'.
σοῦ, genitive of σύ (some 95% of Plato's uses; τοῦ σοῦ is the possessive); Morpheus puts σεύω 'drive' first, and ranking would file it under σός.
πάσῃ, dative of πᾶς (ἐν πάσῃ τῇ Ἑλλάδι, Alc. I 104b); ranking would file it under πάσσω 'sprinkle'.
τροφῆς, genitive of τροφή 'nurture'; ranking would file it under τροφεύς.
τροφῇ, dative of τροφή 'nurture' (Alc. I 121b); ranking would file it under τροφέω.
ἔσθ', elided ἔστι (οὐκ ἔσθ' ὅτῳ, Alc. I 123d); Morpheus puts epic ἔσθω 'eat' first, and ranking would file it under ἔστε 'until'.
νῷ, dative of νοῦς (ἐν νῷ εἶχον, Alc. I 104d); ranking would file it under νάω 'flow'.
οἰκείων, genitive plural of οἰκεῖος; ranking would file it under a glossless οἰκείω.
οἰκεῖον, of οἰκεῖος (Laws 772e); ranking would file it under a glossless οἰκείω.
οἰκείοις, dative plural of οἰκεῖος; ranking would file it under a glossless οἰκείω.
ποτά, 'drinks' (σιτία καὶ ποτά, Gorg. 490b); ranking would file it under ποτή 'flight'.
τιμῇ, dative of τιμή (ἐν μεγάλῃ τιμῇ, Alc. I 121e); ranking would file it under a glossless τιμέω.
νέα, of νέος 'new, young' (Crat. 418b); Morpheus puts the epic accusative of ναῦς first, and ranking would file it under a glossless νέα.
νέας, of νέος 'young' (νέους τε καὶ νέας, Laws 835d); Morpheus puts the epic accusative of ναῦς first, and ranking would file it under a glossless νέα.
ἀκούσῃ, of ἀκούω (ἐάν τε ἀκούσῃ, Ep. VII 335b); ranking would file it under ἀέκων.
θῇ, aorist subjunctive of τίθημι (ὅπου ἄν τις αὐτὰ θῇ, Euthphr. 11c); ranking would file it under θέω 'run'.
θῶ, aorist subjunctive of τίθημι (Prot. 322d); ranking would file it under θάζω.
θῆται, aorist subjunctive middle of τίθημι (ἃ ἂν θῆται πόλις, Tht. 172b); ranking would file it under θάω.
νομῆς, genitive of νομή 'pasturage' (Laws 677b); ranking would file it under νομεύς.
τομῆς, genitive of τομή 'cutting' (σκυτῶν τομῆς, Charm. 173d); ranking would file it under τομεύς.
εἰσαγωγῆς, genitive of εἰσαγωγή 'import' (Laws 847d); ranking would file it under εἰσαγωγεύς.
ἐκλογῆς, genitive of ἐκλογή 'selection' (Laws 670e); ranking would file it under ἐκλογεύς.
τροπῇ, dative of τροπή 'turning' (Polit. 271b); ranking would file it under τροπέω.
αὐγῇ, dative of αὐγή 'light' (ἐν αὐγῇ καθαρᾷ, Phaedr. 250c); ranking would file it under αὐγέω.
ὁρμῇ, dative of ὁρμή 'onset' (μιᾷ ὁρμῇ, Tim. 25b); ranking would file it under ὁρμέω 'lie at anchor'.
ἐπιστάτην, accusative of ἐπιστάτης 'overseer' (Apol. 20a); ranking would file it under a glossless feminine ἐπιστάτη.
ἀνῇς, aorist subjunctive of ἀνίημι (οὐ γὰρ μὴ ἀνῇς ἐρωτῶν, Euthd. 297d); ranking would file it under a glossless ἀνέω.
προστάξῃ, of προστάσσω (οἷς ἂν ὁ νόμος προστάξῃ, Laws 745a); ranking would file it under προσστάζω 'drop on'.
ἀξιώσῃ, of ἀξιόω (ὃν ἂν ἀξιώσῃ, Laws 923c); ranking would file it under a glossless ἀξιάω.
ἀναγκαίαις, of ἀναγκαῖος (Prot. 346b); ranking would file it under a glossless ἀναγκαίη.
βιώσῃ, 'you will live', of βιόω (Crito 53e); ranking would file it under βιάω 'constrain'.
ζημιώσῃ, of ζημιόω 'penalize' (Laws 933e); ranking would file it under ζημιάζω.
